author: WqR_
body:
Application
My age is 15 and my timezone is UTC +1 i have acces to both skype and teamspeak. i don't have any recoding software but will get it soon. 


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
I have little experience to be a staff member but only on smaller servers that isn't well known and is down by now.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
My weakness is not being allowed to say my opinion on discussions, however my strength is to get people to change their mind such as hacking and spamming.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
 I guess i could change the enviroment of the staff team if its not already good. The qualities i think a leader should have is discipline and encouragement.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
 I don't consider myself as a leader however i may rather be a funny sidekick helping the leaders such as you guys :D

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
My attributes that i think qualifies me to be a moderator is that i am always kind to people and let they say their own opinion on the thing we are discussing.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
The skills i think is needed when interacting with the community is kindness and and to rough with them.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
 Im available around about 1-2 hours a day and 4+ hours on the weekend if i don't have exams.

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
If it is a ban evader online hacking. first, i would let you guys know about it, then i would try to find out the ip and see which acoounts he has. Then i would try to get as close to him as possible to try to make him change his mind. Or else i would wait untill another mod comes on.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
When it is a staff member harrassing people, i would try to ask him why he is doing it then i will talk with him and try to change his mind.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
When there is no evidence of a playerhacking i would accept the apeal and if im allowed to id go invis to so no one knows im online, then i would see what he does while im recording.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
When someone posts as screenie of a post only staff can see don't know what to do to be honnest. i would try to ask other staff member for advice on what to do next time this happens.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
When i don't agree with a decision i would try to argue with the person who came up with the idea and then i would say what else we can do than that decision.

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
To get moderator on avicus would make me happy because i really like to make a server better when it has so big potential.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
I really love Avicus Network because it has one of the best gamemode which isn't only pvp. It's also tactics and how to come up with the best result. I would do anything to make Avicus a really big network such as Mineplex and Hypixel. Right now Avicus is alot more fun than both of the server. it would be even better if the server is big and has alot of players online 24/7. Avicus is right now the only server i know of that has the gamemode called "Project Ares" which is my favorite gamemode.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
The other languages i speak other than English is Swedish, Norwegian and im also learning Spanish so ill get better the longer time goes.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
Other things i would like to add in my applications is that your server is the best and i wish the best luck further and hope you become big. <3
